definitions.explanation: Prefix indicating opposition or being against something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
{反戦|はんせん}⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反感|はんかん}→反感：08675_hankan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

notes:
{反|はん}〜 is a prefix meaning 'anti-' or 'counter-.'

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧ (opposition; opposite)
- ⟦{反感|はんかん}→反感：08675_hankan⟧ (antipathy; ill will)
- ⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧ (reflection; reconsideration)
- ⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧ (reaction; response)
- ⟦{反論|はんろん}→反論：08677_hanron⟧ (counterargument)
- ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ (repulsion; opposition)
- {反戦|はんせん} (anti-war)
- {反社会的|はんしゃかいてき} (antisocial)
- ⟦{反抗|はんこう}→反抗：03568_hankou⟧ (resistance; defiance)
- ⟦{反則|はんそく}→反則：06541_hansoku⟧ (foul; violation)

USAGE:
Different from ⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧〜 (half), which is a homophone.
- ⟦{反|はん}{対|たい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧ = opposition
- ⟦{半|はん}{分|ぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧ = half
